content: Standard pattern for Next.js Server Actions + react-hook-form + zod: define one zod schema, validate client-side via zodResolver for instant feedback, and re-validate server-side inside the Server Action via schema.safeParse(Object.fromEntries(formData)) since safeParse returns a result object (never throws), which is what makes the action's return value serializable for useActionState. Server-side validation is mandatory regardless of client validation since a no-JS client can submit anything. This matches the project's existing lib/validation/auth.ts + app/login/actions.ts pattern exactly.
